bills.summary: Electoral mini-reform changing the Electoral Code, party law and election law.
Changes the ineligibility law (Lei de Inelegibilidade) and election law.
Creates the Ministry of Entrepreneurship, Micro and Small Business.
Changes how parliamentary budget amendments are handled, including a reserve for emergencies.
Opens an extraordinary R$360.9 million credit for defence, regional development and social ministries.
Creates incentivised self-regularisation of federal tax debts.
Recognises the BR-319 highway as critical infrastructure and guarantees its passability.
Extends tax payment deadlines for small firms in states of public calamity.
Sets a deadline for municipalities' urban mobility plans.
Provides for liquidation, amnesty and rebates of rural-credit debts.
Extends the deadline for using Paulo Gustavo Law culture funds.
Sets national guidelines for the high-school curriculum (Novo Ensino Médio).
Creates compulsory insurance for victims of road accidents.
Sets spending for the programme that pays high-school students to stay in school.
Approves the updated international convention on seafarer training and certification.
Makes voluntary approach of an aggressor a crime of breaching a protective order.
Changes the Civil Code on monetary adjustment and interest.
Creates the Development Credit Bill (LCD) to fund development lending.
Allows accelerated depreciation of new machinery and equipment.
Updates the income-tax exemption bracket automatically to two minimum wages.
Sets a simplified process to split municipalities to resolve territorial disputes.
Updates the legal regime of the Embratur tourism promotion agency.
Creates commissioned functions at the Supreme Federal Court.
Opens an extraordinary R$30 million credit for the Justice Ministry.
Creates the Mover green mobility and innovation programme with tax incentives.
Grants vehicle-tax (IPVA) immunity to specified vehicles.
Votes on keeping the Supreme Court's preventive arrest of a federal deputy.
Creates career paths and staffing plans for the indigenous affairs agency Funai.
Regulates the tax reform: creates IBS, CBS and the Selective Tax.
Tightens rules for deducting retiree-association fees from pensions.
Lets solar cooperatives use the FGO credit guarantee fund.
Changes the composition of the Federal Council of the OAB.
Opens an extraordinary R$12.2 billion credit for several federal bodies.
